message.content: The links page is hard to scan. Show each link's site name and favicon, and show a friendly message when there are no links yet.
Don't load favicons from Google or any outside service, privacy matters to us. Just show the first letter of the site in a coloured circle instead.
You're done with the change. Now hand it to the human reviewer: read <path> and write handover.storydiff at the repo root, following it exactly.
